inputs.power_unit: W current per rail, not summed
inputs.gain: recorded diagnostic; not a separate heat input

seed_limit: Numerical initialization only, not identified thermal quantities or a searched grid
initial_state: xf from then-observed TJ minus causal T_ref; xs unknown estimated using past-only 60-second initialization block, separate per continuous segment
preprocessing: full accepted 1-second irregular observations, referenced successful PWM as-of <=2.5 s; no gap bridging, no five-second origin subsampling
ambient: unmeasured; locally stationary assumption and centered-state offset, no invented TTP or ambient temperature
fit: single bounded positivity-constrained nonlinear least-squares with fixed Huber scale 0.3 C, stable matrix propagation with actual dt and zero-order-held current inputs; no model/parameter grid expansion
identifiability: check rank/Jacobian/parameter correlation and segment/block sensitivity; PWM closed-loop and rails strongly collinear; no real heat-capacity claim
nested_reduction: If rank inadequate, fix b_5v=0 without combining rails; compare simpler one-state structure, do not presume two states

future_inputs.primary: hold each last valid independent rail and successful PWM known at origin
future_inputs.planned_scenario: only use advance-known schedule and label assumption
forbidden: future temperature to estimate current state

evaluation: development-only purged time windows, fixed parameters before outcome comparison, 15/45/90 s common origins plus source pulse coverage and underprediction; no 18-independent-events claim
confirmation: future unused continuous process needed; not collected in this task
